column1: # Fleetforge agent partition table — layout id "ab-4m-v1".
# FROZEN AT R0. CRITICAL.md: "Partition table ... Wrong at R0 = physical recall of the fleet."
# Derived from design/architecture.md -> Flash-time immutables and
# 0x1E0000 == 1966080 == the ota_slot_size the protocol promises. Do not change either alone.
# No `factory` partition on purpose: a factory-only board can never OTA its way to A/B.
# ff_cfg is the flash-time configuration blob the browser flasher writes per board
# (broker URL + Wi-Fi creds + enrollment token). A partition cannot be added by OTA
# is reserved now even though R0-fw-1/R0-fe-3 define its payload format.
